How It Was Made:

• Discrete Multichannel Extraction: Each track was unpacked into its discrete object-based channels (up to 24 channels). In these spatial studio mixes, the audio is split across separate layers—some channels contain purely instrumental parts, while others combine remaining musical elements with the lead and backing vocals.

• Untouched Pure Stems: All purely instrumental channels (such as isolated bass, guitars, drums, and synth pads) were preserved 100% intact without any AI processing, retaining their original studio clarity, punch, and dynamic range.

• Targeted Vocal Isolation: Neural network filtering using top-tier paid AI models was applied strictly to the hybrid channels containing both music and vocals—allowing the AI to cleanly extract the remaining instruments without damaging the untouched core stems.

• Precision Mastering: All stems were phase-accurately summed back into stereo, level-matched with transparent peak limiting (-0.5 dB), and converted to 16-bit FLAC using triangular dithering.

• Unique Spatial Mix: These instrumental tracks will differ from the well-known 26-year-old CD versions, as they were specially remixed from the studio multitracks for this spatial release.


Note: Only tracks sourced from true studio multitracks are included in this release; stereo upmixes from the 360RA edition were intentionally excluded to maintain maximum audio fidelity.
